jobs.how: Set Demand Config 4, 5 or 6 at the boiler, write the AV 0 bits, then send BV 0, AV 2 or both. Resend AV 0 before each command and refresh commands at least every 4 minutes.

Write: BAS enable / call for heat

Write: packed word of binary value commands

Write tank temperature, °C; rewrite every few seconds

Write system supply temperature, °C; rewrite every few seconds

Read the status code for each heat exchanger; 40 means lockout, and only then is the lockout code valid. Blocking codes show soft lockouts.

points.use: Read: unit 1 lockout code, valid at status 40
Read: unit 2 lockout code, valid at status 40

jobs.how: Switch status points repeat for heat exchanger 1 and 2. Read them to see which safety or proving switch stopped a unit.

checklist: Fit the Lochinvar Modbus/BACnet communication board and set the MAC on dip switches 1-8 (0-127) and baud on switches 9-10 (9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800).
Discover the device at instance 630000 + MAC address (the base is model dependent and can be changed).
Before taking control, poll AI 13/AI 22 (status codes) and AI 8/AI 17 (outlet temperatures); the board is monitor-only until BMS mode is active.
At the boiler set Demand Config 4, 5 or 6, the BMS Type (Power or Setpoint), and the Modbus / BACnet Timeout under Main > Setup > BMS.
Write AV 0 (Configuration) with the bits for every value the BAS will supply, and resend it before each command.
Test control: write BV 0 (Boiler Enable) on and, in Demand Config 5 or 6, AV 2 (rate command), then check BI 7/BI 22 (flame) and AI 11/AI 20 (firing rate).
Keep rewriting BAS temperatures every few seconds and commands at least every 4 minutes; stop the writes once to confirm the unit reverts to local control.
In a cascade, note that only the Leader needs the board for control and then reports cascade totals; fit a board to every unit to see each one.
Map alarms on AI 15/AI 24 (lockout codes, valid at status 40), AI 14/AI 23 (blocking codes) and BI 33/BI 41 (alarm contacts).
